title: let the Tests line say that the gate relied on ork's round results instead of forcing 0 passed 0 failed

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-152522-c419, project ork, item S394. The gate is told not to run the suite and to accept ork's round check as the tests-green evidence (`internal/engine/states.go:909`, `internal/engine/brief.go:441`). It must still print `Tests: N passed, M failed` with "the counts of the run you made" (`internal/roles/prompts/gate.md:169`). `testsLine` (`internal/engine/report.go:116`) accepts only that form, so a gate that ran nothing has to print a made-up `0 passed, 0 failed`. The approval card then shows those zeros as if they were counts.

Merged from S630: `gate.md:168` shows the Tests line as a list item (`- one line ...`), but `testsLine` anchors at line start and refuses a leading `- `.

Owner decisions, both recorded (adj 635, `gate.tests-line-form`; adj 636, `gate.tests-line-list-item`):
- ork accepts the standalone line `Tests: relied on ork round results`. It sets `HasTests`, leaves the counts at 0, and the approval card prints it.
- ork accepts the Tests line, in either form, with a leading list marker (`listMarker`, `internal/engine/report.go:132`).

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 635 (reliance line), adj 636 (list marker accepted) and adj 638 (only the gate may use the reliance line).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestCheckReportTestsLineAcceptsListMarker (`internal/engine/report_test.go`, beside TestCheckReportTestsLine): implementer and gate accept bullet and numbered markers with spaces or tabs, retain counts, and refuse indentation, inline text, trailing text and cross-line markers.
- TestCheckReportGateAcceptsRelianceLine (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): gate accepts bare and list-marked reliance lines, sets HasTests and RelianceOnRound, and leaves counts zero.
- TestCheckReportRelianceLineKeepsItsShape (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): refuse suffix, casing, inline, indentation and truncation variants; mixed reliance and failing counts preserve Failed and refuse PASS.
- TestCheckReportRelianceLineIsGateOnly (`internal/engine/report_test.go`): implementer and part refuse reliance with a Tests shape problem (adj 638); gate control accepts it.
- TestGateRelianceLineBuildsTheApprovalCard (`internal/engine/approval_test.go`, beside TestGatePassBuildsTheApprovalCard): gate reliance report reaches approval with PASS, zero counts and RelianceOnRound true; existing counts card keeps it false.
- TestApprovalCardPrintsRelianceLine (`internal/tui/card_test.go`, beside TestApprovalCardShowsVerdictTestsDiffstat): actual card view prints Gate PASS (round 1)  Tests: relied on ork round results without zero counts; existing numeric view stays intact.
- TestGatePromptNamesTheRelianceLine (`internal/roles/roles_test.go`, beside TestImplementerAndGateShowTheTestsLineLiterally): names both forms and the no-tests reliance condition.
- TestGateBriefChecklistNamesTheRelianceLine (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`, beside TestReviewerAndGateDoneWhen): checklist and gateCriteria name both forms and when to use reliance.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/report.go`, change `testsLine` to take an optional leading list marker (a bullet or number then spaces or tabs, no other leading whitespace), matching `listMarker`. Write the optional group as `[ \t]+`, not `\s+`, so a `(?m)` match cannot cross a newline. Add `relianceLine`, `(?m)^(?:(?:[-*+]|\d+[.)])[ \t]+)?Tests: relied on ork round results\r?$`, with a comment citing adj 635 and adj 636. Add `RelianceOnRound bool` to `Report`.
2. In `CheckReport`, for `RoleGate` only (pending the owner's answer below), look for `relianceLine` before the "no Tests line" problem. When it matches, set `rep.RelianceOnRound` and `rep.HasTests` and add nothing to the counts. Keep the problem text `no "Tests: N passed, M failed" line` for a report with neither form. Counts lines still add up and `PASS reports failed tests` still applies.
3. In `internal/runrec/record.go`, add `RelianceOnRound bool` with a JSON tag and `omitempty` to `ApprovalCard`. In `buildCard` (`internal/engine/approval.go:169`) set it from `rep.RelianceOnRound`.
4. In `internal/tui/card.go` `cardSummary`, when `card.RelianceOnRound` is set, build the first line as `Gate VERDICT (round N)  Tests: relied on ork round results`. Otherwise keep the counts line.
5. In `internal/roles/prompts/gate.md`:
   - Replace line 169 with one line that says `Tests: N passed, M failed` with the counts of tests you ran, or, when you ran no tests and relied on ork's round check, the line `Tests: relied on ork round results`.
   - Keep the literal `Tests: N passed, M failed` code block.
   - Add the reliance line to the "must appear exactly as shown" paragraph (line 176) as a second allowed form, and drop the reference to a made-up count.
   - Keep `Tests: N passed, M failed` named in backticks and in the standalone code block, because `roles_test.go:232-241` and `:580` read them.
6. In `internal/engine/states.go` `gateCriteria` (line 911) and the gate checklist line in `internal/engine/brief.go:449`, add the reliance line as the form to use when the gate ran no tests, and keep `Tests: N passed, M failed` for counts of tests it did run.
7. In `docs/design.md:2243-2246`, state that the gate may instead report `Tests: relied on ork round results`, which the card prints, and that either Tests form may start with a list marker. In `docs/dashboard.md:1281`, say the card prints `Tests: relied on ork round results` in place of the counts in that case.
8. Add the tests listed under Failing tests. They fail before steps 1-6 and pass after.
9. Add the changelog entry: `slicer changelog add S521 --text "..."`.
